newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: SOCCER-COSTA RICA SACK SECOND COACH THIS YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COSTA RICA SACK SECOND COACH THIS YEAR.

text.p: Costa Rica have sacked their second coach this year following last Sunday's 0-0 home draw with El Salvador in a World Cup qualifier.

Argentine Horacio Cordero was jeered by the crowd after a dismal performance by Costa Rica who had a one-man advantage for half the match. He was dismissed after a meeting on Wednesday night but no replacement has been named.

Brazil's Valdeir Vieira, who guided the team to the final stage of the CONCACAF qualifying tournament, was dismissed in January because he refused to drop a claim for unpaid wages against a local club he previously coached.

Sunday's result left Costa Rica second in the six-team group but with only one of their remaining four games at home and only three points between them and the bottom team. The top three qualify for France next year.
